title: Brain Training
subtitle: Focus and memory games for a regular brain-activity habit
disclaimer: This feature is not a medical device and is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any medical condition.
worry: If you are worried about your memory, please talk to a doctor or a local health service rather than playing more games.

training.title: Today's Training
training.desc: Quick Eye and 3 games · about {{minutes}} min
training.dose: About three 20-minute sessions a week is the plan. Playing more is fine, but it earns nothing extra.
training.doneBody: Nice work. A day or two of rest before the next one is fine.
training.quitBody: Your records so far are saved. Because it wasn't finished, it doesn't count as a completed session.
training.stopBody: Everything so far is saved, but an unfinished session doesn't count as a completed one.

home.freePlayHint: Pick one game to practise. A round ends when your chances are used up.
home.howItWorks: Each puzzle is made fresh. Get it right and the next is a little harder; miss and it eases off. Levels show your skill at that game only — they are not a measure of memory or brain health.

settings.title: Brain Training settings
settings.timingHelp: Give timed games more time, or none at all. In the longer modes, running out of time doesn't cost a chance.
settings.centerOnlyHelp: Turn on if the star at the edges is hard to see. You'll only answer the centre picture.
settings.flash: Quick Eye shows pictures very briefly. If you are sensitive to flashing light, take it easy.
settings.soundHelp: A short sound when you get one right or wrong.
settings.hapticsHelp: A short vibration when you get one right or wrong. Same as the app-wide vibration setting.

quickEye.name: Quick Eye
quickEye.desc: See a centre picture and a star at the edge for a split second, then say what and where.

memoryGrid.name: Flash Grid
memoryGrid.desc: Spatial memory practice: remember the cells that lit up, then tap them.

sequence.name: Sequence
sequence.desc: Order memory practice: tap the tiles in the order they flashed.

pairs.name: Match Pairs
pairs.desc: Flip two cards at a time to find matching pictures.

schulte.name: Number Hunt
schulte.desc: Find and tap the scattered numbers in order.

oddOneOut.name: Odd One Out
oddOneOut.desc: All the same but one. Spot it.

stroop.name: Color Word
stroop.desc: Pick the colour of the ink, not the word you read.

math.name: Quick Math
math.desc: Work it out and pick the answer.

series.name: Number Pattern
series.desc: Find the rule and pick the next number.

play.tapLit: Tap the cells that were lit · {{left}} left
play.watchReverse: Watch — you will repeat it backwards
play.findOdd: Tap the one that is different
play.void: The screen stuttered — let's show that again
play.practiceHint: Practice — no chances or points at stake.
play.stopConfirm: Stop here? Your records so far are saved.

quickEye.sameOrDifferent: Were the two centre pictures the same?

summary.improved: Your record in this game improved

intro.practiceNote: The first 4 are practice. They cost no chances and score no points.
